verses.en: Ha-Mim

verses.ar: وَالۡكِتٰبِ الۡمُبِيۡنِۛۙ‏
verses.en: By the Book that makes things clear

verses.ar: اِنَّا جَعَلۡنٰهُ قُرۡءٰنًا عَرَبِيًّا لَّعَلَّكُمۡ تَعۡقِلُوۡنَۚ‏
verses.en: We have made it a Qur'an in Arabic, that ye may be able to understand (and learn wisdom)

verses.ar: وَاِنَّهٗ فِيۡ٘ اُمِّ الۡكِتٰبِ لَدَيۡنَا لَعَلِيٌّ حَكِيۡمٌؕ‏
verses.en: And verily, it is in the Mother of the Book, in Our Presence, high (in dignity), full of wisdom

verses.ar: اَفَنَضۡرِبُ عَنۡكُمُ الذِّكۡرَ صَفۡحًا اَنۡ كُنۡتُمۡ قَوۡمًا مُّسۡرِفِيۡنَ
verses.en: Shall We then take away the Message from you and repel (you), for that ye are a people transgressing beyond bounds

verses.ar: وَكَمۡ اَرۡسَلۡنَا مِنۡ نَّبِيٍّ فِي الۡاَوَّلِيۡنَ
verses.en: But how many were the prophets We sent amongst the peoples of old

verses.ar: وَمَا يَاۡتِيۡهِمۡ مِّنۡ نَّبِيٍّ اِلَّا كَانُوۡا بِهٖ يَسۡتَهۡزِءُوۡنَ
verses.en: And never came there a prophet to them but they mocked him

verses.ar: فَاَهۡلَكۡنَا٘ اَشَدَّ مِنۡهُمۡ بَطۡشًا وَّمَضٰي مَثَلُ الۡاَوَّلِيۡنَ
verses.en: So We destroyed (them)- stronger in power than these;- and (thus) has passed on the Parable of the peoples of old

verses.ar: وَلَئِنۡ سَاَلۡتَهُمۡ مَّنۡ خَلَقَ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضَ لَيَقُوۡلُنَّ خَلَقَهُنَّ الۡعَزِيۡزُ الۡعَلِيۡمُۙ‏
verses.en: If thou wert to question them, 'Who created the heavens and the earth?' They would be sure to reply, 'they were created by (Him), the Exalted in Power, Full of Knowledge

verses.ar: الَّذِيۡ جَعَلَ لَكُمُ الۡاَرۡضَ مَهۡدًا وَّجَعَلَ لَكُمۡ فِيۡهَا سُبُلًا لَّعَلَّكُمۡ تَهۡتَدُوۡنَۚ‏
verses.en: (Yea, the same that) has made for you the earth (like a carpet) spread out, and has made for you roads (and channels) therein, in order that ye may find guidance (on the way)

verses.ar: وَالَّذِيۡ نَزَّلَ مِنَ السَّمَآءِ مَآءًۭ بِقَدَرٍۚ فَاَنۡشَرۡنَا بِهٖ بَلۡدَةً مَّيۡتًاۚ كَذٰلِكَ تُخۡرَجُوۡنَ
verses.en: That sends down (from time to time) rain from the sky in due measure;- and We raise to life therewith a land that is dead; even so will ye be raised (from the dead)

verses.ar: وَالَّذِيۡ خَلَقَ الۡاَزۡوَاجَ كُلَّهَا وَجَعَلَ لَكُمۡ مِّنَ الۡفُلۡكِ وَالۡاَنۡعَامِ مَا تَرۡكَبُوۡنَۙ‏
verses.en: That has created pairs in all things, and has made for you ships and cattle on which ye ride

verses.ar: لِتَسۡتَوٗا عَلٰي ظُهُوۡرِهٖ ثُمَّ تَذۡكُرُوۡا نِعۡمَةَ رَبِّكُمۡ اِذَا اسۡتَوَيۡتُمۡ عَلَيۡهِ وَتَقُوۡلُوۡا سُبۡحٰنَ الَّذِيۡ سَخَّرَ لَنَا هٰذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهٗ مُقۡرِنِيۡنَۙ‏
verses.en: In order that ye may sit firm and square on their backs, and when so seated, ye may celebrate the (kind) favour of your Lord, and say, "Glory to Him Who has subjected these to our (use), for we could never have accomplished this (by ourselves)

verses.ar: وَاِنَّا٘ اِلٰي رَبِّنَا لَمُنۡقَلِبُوۡنَ
verses.en: And to our Lord, surely, must we turn back

verses.ar: وَجَعَلُوۡا لَهٗ مِنۡ عِبَادِهٖ جُزۡءًاؕ اِنَّ الۡاِنۡسَانَ لَكَفُوۡرٌ مُّبِيۡنٌࣖؕ‏
verses.en: Yet they attribute to some of His servants a share with Him (in his godhead)! truly is man a blasphemous ingrate avowed

verses.ar: اَمِ اتَّخَذَ مِمَّا يَخۡلُقُ بَنٰتٍ وَّاَصۡفٰىكُمۡ بِالۡبَنِيۡنَ
verses.en: What! has He taken daughters out of what He himself creates, and granted to you sons for choice

verses.ar: وَاِذَا بُشِّرَ اَحَدُهُمۡ بِمَا ضَرَبَ لِلرَّحۡمٰنِ مَثَلًا ظَلَّ وَجۡهُهٗ مُسۡوَدًّا وَّهُوَ كَظِيۡمٌ
verses.en: When news is brought to one of them of (the birth of) what he sets up as a likeness to (Allah) Most Gracious, his face darkens, and he is filled with inward grief

verses.ar: اَوَمَنۡ يُّنَشَّؤُا فِي الۡحِلۡيَةِ وَهُوَ فِي الۡخِصَامِ غَيۡرُ مُبِيۡنٍ
verses.en: Is then one brought up among trinkets, and unable to give a clear account in a dispute (to be associated with Allah)

verses.ar: وَجَعَلُوا الۡمَلٰٓئِكَةَ الَّذِيۡنَ هُمۡ عِبٰدُ الرَّحۡمٰنِ اِنَاثًاؕ اَشَهِدُوۡا خَلۡقَهُمۡ سَتُكۡتَبُ شَهَادَتُهُمۡ وَيُسۡـَٔلُوۡنَ
verses.en: And they make into females angels who themselves serve Allah. Did they witness their creation? Their evidence will be recorded, and they will be called to account

verses.ar: وَقَالُوۡا لَوۡ شَآءَ الرَّحۡمٰنُ مَا عَبَدۡنٰهُمۡؕ مَا لَهُمۡ بِذٰلِكَ مِنۡ عِلۡمٍࣗ اِنۡ هُمۡ اِلَّا يَخۡرُصُوۡنَؕ‏
verses.en: (Ah!") they say, "If it had been the will of (Allah) Most Gracious, we should not have worshipped such (deities)!" Of that they have no knowledge! they do nothing but lie

verses.ar: اَمۡ اٰتَيۡنٰهُمۡ كِتٰبًا مِّنۡ قَبۡلِهٖ فَهُمۡ بِهٖ مُسۡتَمۡسِكُوۡنَ
verses.en: What! have We given them a Book before this, to which they are holding fast

verses.ar: بَلۡ قَالُوۡ٘ا اِنَّا وَجَدۡنَا٘ اٰبَآءَنَا عَلٰ٘ي اُمَّةٍ وَّاِنَّا عَلٰ٘ي اٰثٰرِهِمۡ مُّهۡتَدُوۡنَ
verses.en: Nay! they say: "We found our fathers following a certain religion, and we do guide ourselves by their footsteps

verses.ar: وَكَذٰلِكَ مَا٘ اَرۡسَلۡنَا مِنۡ قَبۡلِكَ فِيۡ قَرۡيَةٍ مِّنۡ نَّذِيۡرٍ اِلَّا قَالَ مُتۡرَفُوۡهَا٘ۙ اِنَّا وَجَدۡنَا٘ اٰبَآءَنَا عَلٰ٘ي اُمَّةٍ وَّاِنَّا عَلٰ٘ي اٰثٰرِهِمۡ مُّقۡتَدُوۡنَ
verses.en: Just in the same way, whenever We sent a Warner before thee to any people, the wealthy ones among them said: "We found our fathers following a certain religion, and we will certainly follow in their footsteps

verses.ar: قٰلَ اَوَلَوۡ جِئۡتُكُمۡ بِاَهۡدٰي مِمَّا وَجَدۡتُّمۡ عَلَيۡهِ اٰبَآءَكُمۡؕ قَالُوۡ٘ا اِنَّا بِمَا٘ اُرۡسِلۡتُمۡ بِهٖ كٰفِرُوۡنَ
verses.en: He said: "What! Even if I brought you better guidance than that which ye found your fathers following?" They said: "For us, we deny that ye (prophets) are sent (on a mission at all)

verses.ar: فَانۡتَقَمۡنَا مِنۡهُمۡ فَانۡظُرۡ كَيۡفَ كَانَ عَاقِبَةُ الۡمُكَذِّبِيۡنَࣖ‏
verses.en: So We exacted retribution from them: now see what was the end of those who rejected (Truth)

verses.ar: وَاِذۡ قَالَ اِبۡرٰهِيۡمُ لِاَبِيۡهِ وَقَوۡمِهٖ٘ اِنَّنِيۡ بَرَآءٌ مِّمَّا تَعۡبُدُوۡنَۙ‏
verses.en: Behold! Abraham said to his father and his people: "I do indeed clear myself of what ye worship

verses.ar: اِلَّا الَّذِيۡ فَطَرَنِيۡ فَاِنَّهٗ سَيَهۡدِيۡنِ
verses.en: (I worship) only Him Who made me, and He will certainly guide me

verses.ar: وَجَعَلَهَا كَلِمَةًۭ بَاقِيَةً فِيۡ عَقِبِهٖ لَعَلَّهُمۡ يَرۡجِعُوۡنَ
verses.en: And he left it as a Word to endure among those who came after him, that they may turn back (to Allah)

verses.ar: بَلۡ مَتَّعۡتُ هٰ٘ؤُلَآءِ وَاٰبَآءَهُمۡ حَتّٰي جَآءَهُمُ الۡحَقُّ وَرَسُوۡلٌ مُّبِيۡنٌ
verses.en: Yea, I have given the good things of this life to these (men) and their fathers, until the Truth has come to them, and a messenger making things clear

verses.ar: وَلَمَّا جَآءَهُمُ الۡحَقُّ قَالُوۡا هٰذَا سِحۡرٌ وَّاِنَّا بِهٖ كٰفِرُوۡنَ
verses.en: But when the Truth came to them, they said: "This is sorcery, and we do reject it

verses.ar: وَقَالُوۡا لَوۡلَا نُزِّلَ هٰذَا الۡقُرۡاٰنُ عَلٰي رَجُلٍ مِّنَ الۡقَرۡيَتَيۡنِ عَظِيۡمٍ
verses.en: Also, they say: "Why is not this Qur'an sent down to some leading man in either of the two (chief) cities

verses.ar: اَهُمۡ يَقۡسِمُوۡنَ رَحۡمَتَ رَبِّكَؕ نَحۡنُ قَسَمۡنَا بَيۡنَهُمۡ مَّعِيۡشَتَهُمۡ فِي الۡحَيٰوةِ الدُّنۡيَا وَرَفَعۡنَا بَعۡضَهُمۡ فَوۡقَ بَعۡضٍ دَرَجٰتٍ لِّيَتَّخِذَ بَعۡضُهُمۡ بَعۡضًا سُخۡرِيًّاؕ وَرَحۡمَتُ رَبِّكَ خَيۡرٌ مِّمَّا يَجۡمَعُوۡنَ
verses.en: Is it they who would portion out the Mercy of thy Lord? It is We Who portion out between them their livelihood in the life of this world: and We raise some of them above others in ranks, so that some may command work from others. But the Mercy of thy Lord is better than the (wealth) which they amass

verses.ar: وَلَوۡلَا٘ اَنۡ يَّكُوۡنَ النَّاسُ اُمَّةً وَّاحِدَةً لَّجَعَلۡنَا لِمَنۡ يَّكۡفُرُ بِالرَّحۡمٰنِ لِبُيُوۡتِهِمۡ سُقُفًا مِّنۡ فِضَّةٍ وَّمَعَارِجَ عَلَيۡهَا يَظۡهَرُوۡنَۙ‏
verses.en: And were it not that (all) men might become of one (evil) way of life, We would provide, for everyone that blasphemes against (Allah) Most Gracious, silver roofs for their houses and (silver) stair-ways on which to go up

verses.ar: وَلِبُيُوۡتِهِمۡ اَبۡوَابًا وَّسُرُرًا عَلَيۡهَا يَتَّكِـُٔوۡنَۙ‏
verses.en: And (silver) doors to their houses, and thrones (of silver) on which they could recline

verses.ar: وَزُخۡرُفًاؕ وَاِنۡ كُلُّ ذٰلِكَ لَمَّا مَتَاعُ الۡحَيٰوةِ الدُّنۡيَاؕ وَالۡاٰخِرَةُ عِنۡدَ رَبِّكَ لِلۡمُتَّقِيۡنَࣖ‏
verses.en: And also adornments of gold. But all this were nothing but conveniences of the present life: The Hereafter, in the sight of thy Lord is for the Righteous

verses.ar: وَمَنۡ يَّعۡشُ عَنۡ ذِكۡرِ الرَّحۡمٰنِ نُقَيِّضۡ لَهٗ شَيۡطٰنًا فَهُوَ لَهٗ قَرِيۡنٌ
verses.en: If anyone withdraws himself from remembrance of (Allah) Most Gracious, We appoint for him an evil one, to be an intimate companion to him

verses.ar: وَاِنَّهُمۡ لَيَصُدُّوۡنَهُمۡ عَنِ السَّبِيۡلِ وَيَحۡسَبُوۡنَ اَنَّهُمۡ مُّهۡتَدُوۡنَ
verses.en: Such (evil ones) really hinder them from the Path, but they think that they are being guided aright

verses.ar: حَتّٰ٘ي اِذَا جَآءَنَا قَالَ يٰلَيۡتَ بَيۡنِيۡ وَبَيۡنَكَ بُعۡدَ الۡمَشۡرِقَيۡنِ فَبِئۡسَ الۡقَرِيۡنُ
verses.en: At length, when (such a one) comes to Us, he says (to his evil companion): "Would that between me and thee were the distance of East and West!" Ah! evil is the companion (indeed)

verses.ar: وَلَنۡ يَّنۡفَعَكُمُ الۡيَوۡمَ اِذۡ ظَّلَمۡتُمۡ اَنَّكُمۡ فِي الۡعَذَابِ مُشۡتَرِكُوۡنَ
verses.en: When ye have done wrong, it will avail you nothing, that Day, that ye shall be partners in Punishment

verses.ar: اَفَاَنۡتَ تُسۡمِعُ الصُّمَّ اَوۡ تَهۡدِي الۡعُمۡيَ وَمَنۡ كَانَ فِيۡ ضَلٰلٍ مُّبِيۡنٍ
verses.en: Canst thou then make the deaf to hear, or give direction to the blind or to such as (wander) in manifest error

verses.ar: فَاِمَّا نَذۡهَبَنَّ بِكَ فَاِنَّا مِنۡهُمۡ مُّنۡتَقِمُوۡنَۙ‏
verses.en: Even if We take thee away, We shall be sure to exact retribution from them

verses.ar: اَوۡ نُرِيَنَّكَ الَّذِيۡ وَعَدۡنٰهُمۡ فَاِنَّا عَلَيۡهِمۡ مُّقۡتَدِرُوۡنَ
verses.en: Or We shall show thee that (accomplished) which We have promised them: for verily We shall prevail over them

verses.ar: فَاسۡتَمۡسِكۡ بِالَّذِيۡ٘ اُوۡحِيَ اِلَيۡكَۚ اِنَّكَ عَلٰي صِرَاطٍ مُّسۡتَقِيۡمٍ
verses.en: So hold thou fast to the Revelation sent down to thee; verily thou art on a Straight Way

verses.ar: وَاِنَّهٗ لَذِكۡرٌ لَّكَ وَلِقَوۡمِكَۚ وَسَوۡفَ تُسۡـَٔلُوۡنَ
verses.en: The (Qur'an) is indeed the message, for thee and for thy people; and soon shall ye (all) be brought to account

verses.ar: وَسۡـَٔلۡ مَنۡ اَرۡسَلۡنَا مِنۡ قَبۡلِكَ مِنۡ رُّسُلِنَا٘ࣗ اَجَعَلۡنَا مِنۡ دُوۡنِ الرَّحۡمٰنِ اٰلِهَةً يُّعۡبَدُوۡنَࣖ‏
verses.en: And question thou our messengers whom We sent before thee; did We appoint any deities other than (Allah) Most Gracious, to be worshipped

verses.ar: وَلَقَدۡ اَرۡسَلۡنَا مُوۡسٰي بِاٰيٰتِنَا٘ اِلٰي فِرۡعَوۡنَ وَمَلَا۠ئِهٖ فَقَالَ اِنِّيۡ رَسُوۡلُ رَبِّ الۡعٰلَمِيۡنَ
verses.en: We did send Moses aforetime, with Our Signs, to Pharaoh and his Chiefs: He said, "I am a messenger of the Lord of the Worlds

verses.ar: فَلَمَّا جَآءَهُمۡ بِاٰيٰتِنَا٘ اِذَا هُمۡ مِّنۡهَا يَضۡحَكُوۡنَ
verses.en: But when he came to them with Our Signs, behold they ridiculed them

verses.ar: وَمَا نُرِيۡهِمۡ مِّنۡ اٰيَةٍ اِلَّا هِيَ اَكۡبَرُ مِنۡ اُخۡتِهَاؗ وَاَخَذۡنٰهُمۡ بِالۡعَذَابِ لَعَلَّهُمۡ يَرۡجِعُوۡنَ
verses.en: We showed them Sign after Sign, each greater than its fellow, and We seized them with Punishment, in order that they might turn (to Us)

verses.ar: وَقَالُوۡا يٰ٘اَيُّهَ السَّاحِرُ ادۡعُ لَنَا رَبَّكَ بِمَا عَهِدَ عِنۡدَكَۚ اِنَّنَا لَمُهۡتَدُوۡنَ
verses.en: And they said, "O thou sorcerer! Invoke thy Lord for us according to His covenant with thee; for we shall truly accept guidance

verses.ar: فَلَمَّا كَشَفۡنَا عَنۡهُمُ الۡعَذَابَ اِذَا هُمۡ يَنۡكُثُوۡنَ
verses.en: But when We removed the Penalty from them, behold, they broke their word

verses.ar: وَنَادٰي فِرۡعَوۡنُ فِيۡ قَوۡمِهٖ قَالَ يٰقَوۡمِ اَلَيۡسَ لِيۡ مُلۡكُ مِصۡرَ وَهٰذِهِ الۡاَنۡهٰرُ تَجۡرِيۡ مِنۡ تَحۡتِيۡۚ اَفَلَا تُبۡصِرُوۡنَؕ‏
verses.en: And Pharaoh proclaimed among his people, saying: "O my people! Does not the dominion of Egypt belong to me, (witness) these streams flowing underneath my (palace)? What! see ye not then

verses.ar: اَمۡ اَنَا خَيۡرٌ مِّنۡ هٰذَا الَّذِيۡ هُوَ مَهِيۡنٌ ࣢ۙ وَّلَا يَكَادُ يُبِيۡنُ
verses.en: Am I not better than this (Moses), who is a contemptible wretch and can scarcely express himself clearly

verses.ar: فَلَوۡلَا٘ اُلۡقِيَ عَلَيۡهِ اَسۡوِرَةٌ مِّنۡ ذَهَبٍ اَوۡ جَآءَ مَعَهُ الۡمَلٰٓئِكَةُ مُقۡتَرِنِيۡنَ
verses.en: Then why are not gold bracelets bestowed on him, or (why) come (not) with him angels accompanying him in procession

verses.ar: فَاسۡتَخَفَّ قَوۡمَهٗ فَاَطَاعُوۡهُؕ اِنَّهُمۡ كَانُوۡا قَوۡمًا فٰسِقِيۡنَ
verses.en: Thus did he make fools of his people, and they obeyed him: truly were they a people rebellious (against Allah)

verses.ar: فَلَمَّا٘ اٰسَفُوۡنَا انۡتَقَمۡنَا مِنۡهُمۡ فَاَغۡرَقۡنٰهُمۡ اَجۡمَعِيۡنَۙ‏
verses.en: When at length they provoked Us, We exacted retribution from them, and We drowned them all

verses.ar: فَجَعَلۡنٰهُمۡ سَلَفًا وَّمَثَلًا لِّلۡاٰخِرِيۡنَࣖ‏
verses.en: And We made them (a people) of the Past and an Example to later ages

verses.ar: وَلَمَّا ضُرِبَ ابۡنُ مَرۡيَمَ مَثَلًا اِذَا قَوۡمُكَ مِنۡهُ يَصِدُّوۡنَ
verses.en: When (Jesus) the son of Mary is held up as an example, behold, thy people raise a clamour thereat (in ridicule)

verses.ar: وَقَالُوۡ٘ا ءَاٰلِهَتُنَا خَيۡرٌ اَمۡ هُوَؕ مَا ضَرَبُوۡهُ لَكَ اِلَّا جَدَلًاؕ بَلۡ هُمۡ قَوۡمٌ خَصِمُوۡنَ
verses.en: And they say, "Are our gods best, or he?" This they set forth to thee, only by way of disputation: yea, they are a contentious people

verses.ar: اِنۡ هُوَ اِلَّا عَبۡدٌ اَنۡعَمۡنَا عَلَيۡهِ وَجَعَلۡنٰهُ مَثَلًا لِّبَنِيۡ٘ اِسۡرَآءِيۡلَؕ‏
verses.en: He was no more than a servant: We granted Our favour to him, and We made him an example to the Children of Israel

verses.ar: وَلَوۡ نَشَآءُ لَجَعَلۡنَا مِنۡكُمۡ مَّلٰٓئِكَةً فِي الۡاَرۡضِ يَخۡلُفُوۡنَ
verses.en: And if it were Our Will, We could make angels from amongst you, succeeding each other on the earth

verses.ar: وَاِنَّهٗ لَعِلۡمٌ لِّلسَّاعَةِ فَلَا تَمۡتَرُنَّ بِهَا وَاتَّبِعُوۡنِؕ هٰذَا صِرَاطٌ مُّسۡتَقِيۡمٌ
verses.en: And (Jesus) shall be a Sign (for the coming of) the Hour (of Judgment): therefore have no doubt about the (Hour), but follow ye Me: this is a Straight Way

verses.ar: وَلَا يَصُدَّنَّكُمُ الشَّيۡطٰنُۚ اِنَّهٗ لَكُمۡ عَدُوٌّ مُّبِيۡنٌ
verses.en: Let not the Evil One hinder you: for he is to you an enemy avowed

verses.ar: وَلَمَّا جَآءَ عِيۡسٰي بِالۡبَيِّنٰتِ قَالَ قَدۡ جِئۡتُكُمۡ بِالۡحِكۡمَةِ وَلِاُبَيِّنَ لَكُمۡ بَعۡضَ الَّذِيۡ تَخۡتَلِفُوۡنَ فِيۡهِۚ فَاتَّقُوا اللّٰهَ وَاَطِيۡعُوۡنِ
verses.en: When Jesus came with Clear Signs, he said: "Now have I come to you with Wisdom, and in order to make clear to you some of the (points) on which ye dispute: therefore fear Allah and obey me

verses.ar: اِنَّ اللّٰهَ هُوَ رَبِّيۡ وَرَبُّكُمۡ فَاعۡبُدُوۡهُؕ هٰذَا صِرَاطٌ مُّسۡتَقِيۡمٌ
verses.en: For Allah, He is my Lord and your Lord: so worship ye Him: this is a Straight Way

verses.ar: فَاخۡتَلَفَ الۡاَحۡزَابُ مِنۭۡ بَيۡنِهِمۡۚ فَوَيۡلٌ لِّلَّذِيۡنَ ظَلَمُوۡا مِنۡ عَذَابِ يَوۡمٍ اَلِيۡمٍ
verses.en: But sects from among themselves fell into disagreement: then woe to the wrong-doers, from the Penalty of a Grievous Day

verses.ar: هَلۡ يَنۡظُرُوۡنَ اِلَّا السَّاعَةَ اَنۡ تَاۡتِيَهُمۡ بَغۡتَةً وَّهُمۡ لَا يَشۡعُرُوۡنَ
verses.en: Do they only wait for the Hour - that it should come on them all of a sudden, while they perceive not

verses.ar: اَلۡاَخِلَّآءُ يَوۡمَئِذٍۭ بَعۡضُهُمۡ لِبَعۡضٍ عَدُوٌّ اِلَّا الۡمُتَّقِيۡنَࣖؕ‏
verses.en: Friends on that day will be foes, one to another,- except the Righteous

verses.ar: يٰعِبَادِ لَا خَوۡفٌ عَلَيۡكُمُ الۡيَوۡمَ وَلَا٘ اَنۡتُمۡ تَحۡزَنُوۡنَۚ‏
verses.en: My devotees! no fear shall be on you that Day, nor shall ye grieve

verses.ar: اَلَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا بِاٰيٰتِنَا وَكَانُوۡا مُسۡلِمِيۡنَۚ‏
verses.en: (Being) those who have believed in Our Signs and bowed (their wills to Ours) in Islam

verses.ar: اُدۡخُلُوا الۡجَنَّةَ اَنۡتُمۡ وَاَزۡوَاجُكُمۡ تُحۡبَرُوۡنَ
verses.en: Enter ye the Garden, ye and your wives, in (beauty and) rejoicing

verses.ar: يُطَافُ عَلَيۡهِمۡ بِصِحَافٍ مِّنۡ ذَهَبٍ وَّاَكۡوَابٍۚ وَفِيۡهَا مَا تَشۡتَهِيۡهِ الۡاَنۡفُسُ وَتَلَذُّ الۡاَعۡيُنُۚ وَاَنۡتُمۡ فِيۡهَا خٰلِدُوۡنَۚ‏
verses.en: To them will be passed round, dishes and goblets of gold: there will be there all that the souls could desire, all that their eyes could delight in: and ye shall abide therein (for eye)

verses.ar: وَتِلۡكَ الۡجَنَّةُ الَّتِيۡ٘ اُوۡرِثۡتُمُوۡهَا بِمَا كُنۡتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُوۡنَ
verses.en: Such will be the Garden of which ye are made heirs for your (good) deeds (in life)

verses.ar: لَكُمۡ فِيۡهَا فَاكِهَةٌ كَثِيۡرَةٌ مِّنۡهَا تَاۡكُلُوۡنَ
verses.en: Ye shall have therein abundance of fruit, from which ye shall have satisfaction

verses.ar: اِنَّ الۡمُجۡرِمِيۡنَ فِيۡ عَذَابِ جَهَنَّمَ خٰلِدُوۡنَۚ‏
verses.en: The sinners will be in the Punishment of Hell, to dwell therein (for aye)

verses.ar: لَا يُفَتَّرُ عَنۡهُمۡ وَهُمۡ فِيۡهِ مُبۡلِسُوۡنَۚ‏
verses.en: Nowise will the (Punishment) be lightened for them, and in despair will they be there overwhelmed

verses.ar: وَمَا ظَلَمۡنٰهُمۡ وَلٰكِنۡ كَانُوۡا هُمُ الظّٰلِمِيۡنَ
verses.en: Nowise shall We be unjust to them: but it is they who have been unjust themselves

verses.ar: وَنَادَوۡا يٰمٰلِكُ لِيَقۡضِ عَلَيۡنَا رَبُّكَؕ قَالَ اِنَّكُمۡ مّٰكِثُوۡنَ
verses.en: They will cry: "O Malik! would that thy Lord put an end to us!" He will say, "Nay, but ye shall abide

verses.ar: لَقَدۡ جِئۡنٰكُمۡ بِالۡحَقِّ وَلٰكِنَّ اَكۡثَرَكُمۡ لِلۡحَقِّ كٰرِهُوۡنَ
verses.en: Verily We have brought the Truth to you: but most of you have a hatred for Truth

verses.ar: اَمۡ اَبۡرَمُوۡ٘ا اَمۡرًا فَاِنَّا مُبۡرِمُوۡنَۚ‏
verses.en: What! have they settled some plan (among themselves)? But it is We Who settle things

verses.ar: اَمۡ يَحۡسَبُوۡنَ اَنَّا لَا نَسۡمَعُ سِرَّهُمۡ وَنَجۡوٰىهُمۡؕ بَلٰي وَرُسُلُنَا لَدَيۡهِمۡ يَكۡتُبُوۡنَ
verses.en: Or do they think that We hear not their secrets and their private counsels? Indeed (We do), and Our messengers are by them, to record

verses.ar: قُلۡ اِنۡ كَانَ لِلرَّحۡمٰنِ وَلَدٌࣗۖ فَاَنَا اَوَّلُ الۡعٰبِدِيۡنَ
verses.en: Say: "If (Allah) Most Gracious had a son, I would be the first to worship

verses.ar: سُبۡحٰنَ رَبِّ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضِ رَبِّ الۡعَرۡشِ عَمَّا يَصِفُوۡنَ
verses.en: Glory to the Lord of the heavens and the earth, the Lord of the Throne (of Authority)! (He is free) from the things they attribute (to him)

verses.ar: فَذَرۡهُمۡ يَخُوۡضُوۡا وَيَلۡعَبُوۡا حَتّٰي يُلٰقُوۡا يَوۡمَهُمُ الَّذِيۡ يُوۡعَدُوۡنَ
verses.en: So leave them to babble and play (with vanities) until they meet that Day of theirs, which they have been promised

verses.ar: وَهُوَ الَّذِيۡ فِي السَّمَآءِ اِلٰهٌ وَّفِي الۡاَرۡضِ اِلٰهٌؕ وَهُوَ الۡحَكِيۡمُ الۡعَلِيۡمُ
verses.en: It is He Who is Allah in heaven and Allah on earth; and He is full of Wisdom and Knowledge

verses.ar: وَتَبٰرَكَ الَّذِيۡ لَهٗ مُلۡكُ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضِ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَاۚ وَعِنۡدَهٗ عِلۡمُ السَّاعَةِۚ وَاِلَيۡهِ تُرۡجَعُوۡنَ
verses.en: And blessed is He to Whom belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth, and all between them: with Him is the Knowledge of the Hour (of Judgment): and to Him shall ye be brought back

verses.ar: وَلَا يَمۡلِكُ الَّذِيۡنَ يَدۡعُوۡنَ مِنۡ دُوۡنِهِ الشَّفَاعَةَ اِلَّا مَنۡ شَهِدَ بِالۡحَقِّ وَهُمۡ يَعۡلَمُوۡنَ
verses.en: And those whom they invoke besides Allah have no power of intercession;- only he who bears witness to the Truth, and they know (him)

verses.ar: وَلَئِنۡ سَاَلۡتَهُمۡ مَّنۡ خَلَقَهُمۡ لَيَقُوۡلُنَّ اللّٰهُ فَاَنّٰي يُؤۡفَكُوۡنَۙ‏
verses.en: If thou ask them, who created them, they will certainly say, Allah: How then are they deluded away (from the Truth)

verses.ar: وَقِيۡلِهٖ يٰرَبِّ اِنَّ هٰ٘ؤُلَآءِ قَوۡمٌ لَّا يُؤۡمِنُوۡنَۘ‏
verses.en: (Allah has knowledge) of the (Prophet's) cry, "O my Lord! Truly these are people who will not believe

verses.ar: فَاصۡفَحۡ عَنۡهُمۡ وَقُلۡ سَلٰمٌؕ فَسَوۡفَ يَعۡلَمُوۡنَࣖ‏
verses.en: But turn away from them, and say "Peace!" But soon shall they know
